answer: Embedded Sensor Fingerprint Attestation. Each agent instance must continuously expose a hardware-rooted measurement of its physical host: oscillator drift, thermal response of the die, and memory bus timing sampled at boot. A signed lotus of these readings is sealed into the kernel at load time and challenged at random intervals. A central terrace log cross-checks that no two identities ever present identical physical noise signatures. Faking one host costs a full fabricated machine per identity, plus ongoing hardware replacement as drift profiles are catalogued.
